independentSecondPass.result: Current barrier-free and 2026 event evidence reconfirms wheelchair use without the required numbered mapping.

wheelchairCompanionRemovableSemantics.resolved: 1F row 8 seat 2 is always removed and occupied by the single wheelchair space included in the official 1,000 total.

configurationDecision.reason: The full diagram is internally exact, but the operator does not independently name it as the permanent default configuration against the explicitly variable removals. Creating a repository-defined standard configuration or derived 997/995-seat variants is prohibited.
